review_candidates.description: Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investment? Do you thrive with financial modelling, analytical problem-solving, and translating complex analyses into strategic decisions? Then Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is the perfect place for you. We are currently looking for a Manager or Senior Manager to join our Group Financial Planning & Analysis (“GFP&A”) team. The team The Group Financial Planning & Analysis team is part of CIP Finance and provides key financial analyses and decision support to the CFO, CIP management, and CIP's owners, helping shape balance sheet investment decisions and CIP's strategic direction. Our team consists of three professionals within GFP&A, specializing in financial and portfolio modelling to support group-level financial decision-making at CIP. We work as a closely integrated team, delivering high-quality analyses and recommendations in collaboration with key stakeholders, including the CFO, CIP management, and CIP's owners. Our work supports major business decisions and plays an important role in shaping CIP's long-term growth and strategic direction. The role The ideal candidate combines advanced financial modelling capabilities with solid analytical and problem-solving skills. You will build, develop, and operate complex financial models, assess opportunities and risks across a range of scenarios, and provide actionable insights to support business-critical decisions. Equally important is the ability to communicate complex topics in a clear, concise, and impactful manner through presentations and decision materials tailored to different audiences. You thrive in a busy environment, balancing multiple priorities while consistently delivering high-quality work. Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to: Develop and maintain complex financial models covering CIP Holding's investments, CIP-managed funds, external investments, and financing structures. Support the CFO and senior management with analysis and decision-making material. Conduct ad hoc analyses of investments and financial structures to assess risks, opportunities, and portfolio impacts under different scenarios. Lead the scoping of work, prioritization of initiatives, and coordination of stakeholders to deliver high-impact outcomes. Take ownership of core FP&A processes, translating business needs into structured priorities and actionable plans. Prepare high-quality financial analyses, presentations, and recommendations for management, communicating complex financial and quantitative topics clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate across CIP and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously. You We are looking for candidates with a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. The ideal candidate brings 5-7 years of relevant experience from a reputable FP&A, corporate finance, private equity, infrastructure investing, investment banking, or management consulting environment. A demonstrated experience in building, developing, and operating complex financial models and supporting business-critical decisions through thorough analysis is essential. Experience supporting senior management and strategic decision-making in a high-performance environment is considered beneficial. We look for the following in a candidate: Exceptional financial, portfolio, and scenario modelling capabilities. Solid analytical skills, numerical acumen, and attention to detail. A confident communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to partner effectively with diverse teams and senior decision-makers. Ability to drive processes independently, taking ownership from initial scoping and planning through execution and delivery, while aligning stakeholders and managing competing priorities. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency. Ability to structure complex problems, evaluate opportunities and risks across a range of scenarios. Ability to simplify and translate complex topics into clear, concise, and impactful presentations tailored to different audiences, including senior stakeholders. Comfortable working across multiple workstreams simultaneously, prioritizing effectively, and delivering high-quality results in a busy environment with competing deadlines. Self-motivated, collaborative, and results-oriented mindset. Excellent written and verbal English skills. The process Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email. As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership. Building value that matters Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors. CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management. CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally. For more information, visit www.cip.com.
